title: 5D point (independent coordinate)
description: An entry or node's POINT (spec/SPEC.md §11): five INDEPENDENT values, each in [0, 1], NOT constrained to sum to 1 — compared by cosine. This is distinct from the SHARES view (schema/position.schema.json, §5), which keeps its own sum-to-1 and all-zero-default shape unchanged. A point's no-contribution floor is ALL-ZERO — the earlier 0.5 'neutral' floor was withdrawn; see five_d_nd/point.py's own docstring.
